title: Can't Delete User on Locally Deployed Supabase: 'Method Not Allowed' Error
body: I recently deployed Supabase locally. In Supabase Studio at http://127.0.0.1:54323, deleting a test user from Authentication fails with “Failed to delete selected users: API error happened while trying to communicate with the server.” The request reports Method Not Allowed. I looked at the Studio source handling the delete request, and it appears as though it should work. Is there a configuration I missed, or is this a bug?

symptoms_visible: When I try to delete a test user from the Authentication section of my local Supabase Studio, Studio says “Failed to delete selected users: API error happened while trying to communicate with the server,” and the request returns Method Not Allowed.
N0.label: N0 local user deletion failure reported

symptoms_visible: User deletion still returns the same API communication error in the local Studio started through the Supabase CLI.
N1.label: N1 affected CLI packaging established

symptoms_visible: After starting the project with CLI 2.9.6, deleting a user still produces the same API communication error, and that CLI still includes the affected Studio image.
N1_x.label: N1_x CLI 2.9.6 update aftermath

symptoms_visible: With the project started using CLI 2.6.7, I can delete the user successfully from Studio.
N2.label: N2 older CLI workaround working

symptoms_visible: The delete operation still fails on CLI 2.12.1, while a test using the 2.15.3 pre-release allows the user to be deleted without an error.
N3.label: N3 corrected pre-release verified

symptoms_visible: After updating to the fixed public CLI release and restarting the local stack, I can delete users from Studio without the Method Not Allowed or API communication error.
N_terminal.label: terminal reporter-confirmed resolution

question_patterns: How are you running Supabase locally: through the Supabase CLI or a self-hosted docker-compose setup?
Which local deployment method are you using?
clarifications.user_answer_in_this_oncall: I'm using the Supabase CLI to run the local project.

counterfactual_candidates.answer: I'm not using the CLI; this is a self-hosted docker-compose deployment where I select the Studio image tag myself.
I'm using the CLI, and I access Studio in a different browser.

edges.comment: Reporter c11 and c17 establish that the opening deployment is CLI-based. In c11 the reporter also volunteers that deletion still fails through 2.9.6 and that reviewing CLI changes shows it still carries the affected older Studio image.

solution.intent: Update the local project to Supabase CLI 2.9.6 on the assumption that its recently pushed Studio image already resolves user deletion.
solution.concrete_example: Install or run Supabase CLI 2.9.6, restart the local stack, and retry deleting the user.

edges.comment: c10 claimed a clean CLI 2.9.6 installation appeared fixed. Reporter c11 retested and rejected that conclusion: deletion still failed, and the CLI still referenced the affected Studio image.

solution.intent: Use CLI 2.6.7 as a temporary rollback because it predates the affected CLI and Studio combination.
solution.concrete_example: Run `npx supabase@2.6.7 start`, or pin `supabase@2.6.7` as a project dev dependency, until a corrected Studio image is included in a newer CLI release.

edges.comment: Reporter c17 states that CLI 2.6.7 works and is the last stable version before the failure. c18 independently confirms that rollback works. This is a temporary workaround, not the eventual fixed release.

solution.intent: Recover from the still-broken 2.9.6 update by rolling the CLI back to the known-working 2.6.7 version.
solution.concrete_example: Stop the current local stack and start it with `npx supabase@2.6.7 start`; pin that CLI version in the project if necessary.

edges.comment: Recovery after the c10-c12 false start. Reporter c17 and another affected CLI user c18 report successful deletion after using 2.6.7.

question_patterns: Can you test the available 2.15.3 pre-release against the same user-deletion operation and report what happens?
After stopping the existing local stack, could you start a test project with CLI 2.15.3 and retry deleting a user?
clarifications.user_answer_in_this_oncall: I encountered the same deletion issue on 2.12.1, but 2.15.3 works: I can delete a user without the error.

counterfactual_candidates.answer: The 2.15.3 pre-release still returns Method Not Allowed when I delete the same user.
The operation works on 2.15.3 after I stop the old stack and start a fresh test project.

edges.comment: c31-c34 show the failure on public CLI 2.12.1 after the earlier fix was reverted because of other bugs. c36-c37 and c43 provide pre-release verification that 2.15.3 restores user deletion. These reports come from other affected CLI users and are folded into the simulated user side; the test is treated as a pre-landing measurement rather than a permanent change to the reporter's pinned 2.6.7 system.

solution.intent: Replace the temporary rollback with the latest public Supabase CLI release that includes the corrected Studio build, restart the local stack, and have the reporter verify user deletion before closing the issue.
solution.concrete_example: Update to CLI 2.15.8, stop the existing local stack as instructed, start it again with the updated CLI, and retry deleting a test user in Studio. Keep the issue open until that succeeds on the reporter's machine.

edges.comment: c44 announces public CLI 2.15.8. c49 and c52 confirm it for other affected CLI users, then maintainer c51 asks the original reporter to verify. Reporter c53 confirms resolution and closes the issue. Later comments about email configuration, table operations, and foreign-key-dependent users are separate problems and are deliberately excluded.

satisfaction_conditions: Must identify the accepted root cause at the level established by the thread: affected Supabase CLI releases packaged a Studio build in which local Dashboard user deletion returned Method Not Allowed; this was not a missing user configuration.
Diagnosis must be grounded in the version evidence: the issue remained on CLI 2.9.6 and 2.12.1, worked when rolled back to 2.6.7, and worked again in the corrected pre-release.
Must recommend moving from the temporary rollback to a public CLI build containing the corrected Studio image and restarting the local CLI stack.
Must not present CLI 2.9.6 or 2.12.1 as the fix; both were shown in the thread to retain the deletion failure.
Must ask the affected reporter to retry deleting a user on the updated stack and must not declare resolution until that verification succeeds.
Must not conflate this issue with self-hosted email-provider configuration, table editing, or deletion failures caused by dependent database rows.

persona_hint.experience_level: Moderately technical local Supabase developer who can inspect browser requests and Studio source, compare CLI releases, pin or run an older CLI version, and verify behavior after updating.
persona_hint.communication_style: Polite and investigative; provides screenshots and source context, checks release contents independently, corrects inaccurate claims with version evidence, and gives concise confirmation when resolved.
